title: Context Correction Suggestions QA
principle: MMIR should learn from explicit user corrections by suggesting safer memory and knowledge hygiene, without silently changing user data.
public_repo_rule: Suggestions are derived from browser-local correction metadata only. They do not store raw prompts, raw responses, document text, provider secrets or paid-route approvals.

scenarios.expected: Repeated or recent memory corrections can suggest scope, expiry, import review or manual source review.
Knowledge corrections can suggest collection review, stale file cleanup or splitting broad collections.
Suggestion buttons only open the relevant local panel; they do not mutate memory, knowledge, routes or paid services.
The progress dashboard renders correction-suggestion QA and local suggestion state for the current workspace.
